ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chicken breast or tenders
½ cup hot sauce or wing sauce
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces if not using tenders.
Marinate chicken in buttermilk, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper for at least 10 minutes.
Mix flour, cornstarch, and breadcrumbs in a shallow bowl.
Dredge marinated chicken in flour mixture, pressing lightly to coat.
Heat oil in a deep skillet or fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Fry chicken in batches until golden brown and cooked through, ~5–6 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels.
For sauce: Mix hot sauce with melted butter, toss cooked wings until coated.
Serve immediately with ranch or blue cheese dipping sauce.
serving_suggestions: Serve with ranch or blue cheese dressing for dipping.
Pair with celery and carrot sticks.
Serve alongside crispy fries or potato wedges.
Drizzle with extra buffalo sauce for added flavor.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
Reheat in oven at 350°F until hot and crispy.
Do not freeze after tossing in sauce; freeze raw fried chicken if desired.
